design_thresholds.explanation: No reviewed source establishes a universal minimum number of OSS projects for fixed-effects panel regression. Thresholds below are prospective design floors chosen from the literature benchmark scale, clustered-inference needs, expected curation attrition, and robustness/subgroup requirements; they are not literature-prescribed constants.

interpretation.below_500: insufficient for the intended high-quality project-level panel design; supplementation reconsidered
interpretation.500_to_749: minimum acceptable design range; proceed only with strong coverage and limited subgroup fragmentation
interpretation.900_plus: strong quantity position relative to the current measurement-oriented design

attrition_stress_test.note: Scenario analysis only; not empirical post-curation counts.
attrition_stress_test.decision: The 24-month GitHub pool can lose up to 46.5% of candidates and still meet N_min=500; the 36-month pool can lose up to 43.9%. This provides substantial curation headroom but does not substitute for actual project-unit validation.

prospective_project_unit_curation_rules.unit: OSS software project represented by one canonical GitHub repository, unless a multi-repository project boundary is prospectively validated and aggregated under a separate rule.
include: public GitHub repository in the frozen OSS Compass single-repository candidate frame
software-development repository rather than documentation/data/course/demo-only repository
canonical project repository rather than fork, mirror, migration copy, package container, or organization/meta repository
repository remains observable across the chosen 24-month or 36-month analysis envelope
project identity and repository boundary can be justified without using performance outcomes
exclude: fork/mirror/migration copy where canonical upstream is distinct
documentation-only, tutorial/course-only, example-only, benchmark-only, or data-only repository when it is not the software project itself
package/container repository that primarily redistributes another upstream project
organization governance/meta repository without direct software-development scope
multi-repository project where the selected repository cannot independently represent the project and complete membership cannot be validly aggregated

sample_lock.reason: Actual project-unit curation and construct-valid variable contract must be completed before the analytic sample can be frozen.

reopen_supplementation_only_if: actual curated GitHub N falls below 500
a frozen construct-critical variable has adequate coverage in fewer than 500 projects
project-boundary validation reveals attrition beyond the 46.5% headroom for the 24-month pool
a required robustness design cannot be estimated with the retained sample
